dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of 200 sentence pairs, where the two sentences in each pair have the same subject and object but differ in the verb. Each pair was ranked by human evaluators on a 1-7 similarity scale.
dcterms:title: Verb Disambiguation Dataset (GS11)

dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of 72 subject-verb-object sentences arranged into 108 sentence pairs. Each pair has a gold standard semantic similarity score on a 1-7 scale.
dcterms:title: Transitive Sentence Similarity Dataset (KS14)
